dual_scenarios.context: 文化报道 / 角色介绍；以已确认的 DC 专名为例
dual_scenarios.ms: Laman rasmi DC memperkenalkan Edward Nygma sebagai watak yang dikenali dengan nama Riddler.

dual_scenarios.en: DC's official website presents Edward Nygma as the character known as the Riddler.

etymology.historical_story: Nygma has a documented cultural reference in DC's Edward Nygma, better known as the Riddler, a Batman adversary associated with puzzles and clues. DC dates the character's first appearance to 1948. This establishes a fictional naming context, not a Malay lexical origin, and does not identify the source of the lowercase token supplied here. See [DC’s official profile](https://www.dc.com/characters/riddler).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境确认是谜语人，可把 E. Nygma 与英语 enigma（谜团）作声音联想；这是记忆提示，不是 nygma 的马来语释义。
